svg.aria-label: The side region foliated by the segments of constant side label tau, of slope 9/4 in the (a, u)-plane; each runs from the tie line up to the circle phi = 13/4 or, beyond the diagonal corner, to the diagonal u = a; the segment of label pi/6 ends at the side state (1, 1/2) and the segment of label pi/4 is the edge V1 V2 of the capped triangle
